popCulture.title: Hecate
popCulture.description: Perses' daughter by Asteria — the crossroads goddess whose cult and triple form eclipse her Titan father's sparse mythology.

popCulture.title: Asteria
popCulture.description: Starry Titaness whom Perses takes as wife — mother of Hecate, sister of Leto in the Coeus–Phoebe line.
